reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the room-temperature passivation film breakdown sequence from P2/P3 with the temperature-dependent phase transformation and Fe³⁺ enrichment findings from P9/P11, and links them through a novel mechanistic chain—thermal-stress-induced microcracking and phase transformation compromising barrier integrity—that none of the passages states. It further proposes a self-healing mixed oxide scale as a conditional stabilizer, an idea not present in the cited literature, and designs a comparative room- vs. high-temperature experiment to isolate this mechanism, going beyond the separate studies.
